levels.name: The Lobby
levels.description: Endless yellow rooms, humming lights, and damp carpet. The first place most wanderers remember.

levels.name: The Habitable Zone
levels.description: A sprawling warehouse with supplies, isolated outposts, and unstable geometry.

levels.name: Sublimity
levels.description: A vast pool complex where familiar architecture gives way to something watching from below.

entities.name: The Hound
entities.description: A fast, hostile entity that imitates human movement before revealing its true form.
entities.advice: Do not run in a straight line. Break line of sight and stay quiet.

entities.name: The Smiler
entities.description: A face visible only in darkness. Its smile is the last warning most explorers receive.
entities.advice: Keep your light steady and never stare directly at it.

documents.title: Field Note 001: Entry
documents.excerpt: If you find this, you have already left the world you knew. Keep moving.

documents.title: Incident Report: Yellow Hall
documents.excerpt: The lights went out for eleven seconds. When they returned, the corridor had changed.
